states.content: Through Monday, only logistical information may be shared with Nina: arrival times, where Marcus needs to go, and basic transportation instructions. Medication changes, lab results, adherence history, and chart notes must not be shared with her. For the tentative Wednesday cardioversion slot, Nina is to be told only the Wednesday time and arrival window, with nothing about the medication plan. Marcus does not want details of his recovery discussed with family; family updates should be limited to the logistics scope he set, and nurse Jamison has agreed to keep family updates within that scope. Marcus wants his sister told the times later, but not the reason anything changes. states.content: Cardioversion remains the plan for Marcus Reed's atrial fibrillation rhythm control. Because the timing of his Monday-night apixaban dose is uncertain, Dr. Patel is changing the approach from direct cardioversion to TEE-guided cardioversion so a clot can be checked for first while still avoiding an unnecessary delay. The Wednesday, March 11 slot was released; the new tentative procedure slot is Thursday, March 12 at 11:10 AM with 9:40 AM arrival, and that Thursday slot is now specifically a TEE-guided cardioversion case. Marcus requests that the procedure slot details be put in the chart. Dr. Patel has reviewed the labs and stated they are acceptable for outpatient cardioversion, satisfying the pending-labs condition; full medication history reconciliation remains part of the plan. Dr. Patel instructs that Marcus must not miss any apixaban doses at all between now and cardioversion, and to continue apixaban exactly as prescribed without missing any further doses. Pharmacist Klein confirms apixaban stays at 5 mg twice daily and Marcus must not stop or skip it on his own unless the cardiologist specifically says otherwise. The only routine periprocedural hold discussed is lisinopril on the morning of the procedure once the date is confirmed. Nurse Jamison will bring Marcus back first for his cardiology rhythm clinic visit, and Nina can be updated on arrival windows if Marcus keeps the logistics-only setting active.
